projects.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Programming Questions

bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the project workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules to extract organization and date spans from public programming questions, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.

projects.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Policy Excerpts

bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, wrote Python functions for parsing provided records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.

As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, compared rule-based and pretrained spaCy extraction on held-out annotated policy excerpts, checked span precision and recall, and analyzed errors by entity type.

As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
